title.narrative: Programme for inclusive and sustainable industrial development in the United Republic of Tanzania

description.narrative: The Programme for Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (PISID) in the United Republic of Tanzania is comprised of four c omponents (sub-projects), namely: 1. Data, Industrial Policies and Strategies (DIPS) 2. Augmenting Results for Industrial Support Entities (ARISE) 3. Developing Industrial Value Chains and Enterprises (DIVE) 4. Coordination, Monitoring and Evaluation (COME).
